name: Bavaria & Munich
about: Oktoberfest (mid-Sep to early Oct) is Munich's busiest, most expensive stretch by far; Dec brings famous Christmas markets, and summer (Jun–Aug) is best for the Bavarian Alps and lake swimming.
overview: Munich's beer halls and Oktoberfest, Neuschwanstein's fairy-tale silhouette, and the medieval towns of the Romantic Road — Germany's most storybook region.
costOverview: Munich stays reasonable outside Oktoberfest — during the festival itself, beer-tent prices and hotel rates both spike hard.

specialSeasons.text: Oktoberfest runs from mid-September to the first Sunday in October — Munich's busiest, most crowded, and most expensive stretch of the year.
Nuremberg's and Munich's Christmas markets are among the most famous in the world.
